answer: The ember register is checked at draw time, yarrow lists the eligible set, and nadir seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 33 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 33 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary burns for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 24 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
